tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The United States Governor of the International Development Association may contribute on behalf of the United States $3,198,552,000 to the twenty-first replenishment of the resources of the Association, subject to obtaining the necessary appropriations.

tree.heading: Authorization of appropriations
tree.text: In order to pay for the United States contribution provided for in subsection (a), there are authorized to be appropriated, without fiscal year limitation, $3,198,552,000 for payment by the Secretary of the Treasury.

notes.heading: Termination of Section
notes.text: For termination of section by section 7070(b)(5) of Pub. L. 119–75, see Termination Date note below.

notes.heading: Termination Date
notes.text: Section to have no force or effect beginning 10 years after Feb. 3, 2026, see section 7070(b)(5) of Pub. L. 119–75, set out as a note under section 262o–5 of this title.
